title: Roar of the Savage Reek
front_description: "Let the executions begin!" announces the Poggle the Lesser, Count Dooku´s evil Geonosian ally. From different gates around the vast arena, three fearsome monsters are driven forward by picadors who carry long spears and ride orrays. The monsters toss their huge heads, Iook around, then roar defiantly to the wild satisfaction of the crowd. Now, they catch sight of the thrce condemned captives and start moving toward them.
back_description: Michael Murnani's finely-detailed sculpture of the Reek, one of three ferocious arena monsters.
